barriers: all six training budgets reconciled and sealed
ldm: Read-only reuse of three frozen r3 winners, training records, selections and test results; no rerun or reselection
historical_run: Preserve r3 sources, budgets, receipts and scientific results; archive reports
test_feedback: Never used for parameter changes, candidate selection or training. Same-benchmark reevaluation, not a first blind test.
timing: Same 120 second hard cap; report measured time; do not claim equal actual time
report: Main comparison only LDM / new MCMC / new ACQ; original histories remain archived
case_visualization: All 48 test cases, each with all 3 discovery seeds x 3 execution seeds; same-coordinate truth/LDM/MCMC/ACQ 3D and orthogonal slices, observations, inactive regions, metrics and measured time. No averaged prediction geometry or cherry-picked cases.
failure_policy: Stop dispatch and preserve evidence; no enlarged cap, free source retry or silent candidate mutation
